svg.title: CCUsageX: the newest flagship project
svg.desc: Spotlight banner for CCUsageX, a local zero-dependency dashboard for Claude Code usage. An animated miniature dashboard shows a live indicator, KPI numbers ticking up, ranked cost columns growing, a sparkline drawing, a cache-hit donut sweeping and a streaming activity list. Live demo at mhjoy99.github.io/CCUsageX. Illustrative demo data.

g.text: See every prompt, token and dollar
